2790-3131.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
Angel of Destiny does not have summoning sickness.
2790-3131.notablePrerequisites:
You control three other creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block flying creatures you control.
2790-3131.description:
Cast Nanogene Conversion by paying its mana cost targeting Angel of Destiny, causing each other creature you control to become a nonlegendary copy of the targeted creature until end of turn.
Move to combat and declare all your Angels as attackers, sending at least one Angel at each opponent.
When first strike damage is dealt, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers for each creature that dealt damage.
Resolve each trigger, causing each opponent to gain life equal to X times the damage they took (where X is the number of Angels you control) and you to gain life equal to that combined total.
Repeat steps 4-5 for the normal damage step.
At the beginning of your end step, since your life total is at least 45, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers, causing the player it attacked to lose the game.

2023-4518-5223-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

687-4613-5231-8130-8136.description:
Cast Biomathematician by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Biomathematician enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Fractal token.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Biomathematician and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Biomathematician from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-4613-5231-8130-8136.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

3490-4742-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4742-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-792-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-792-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2724-3217-3582-6495.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

2842-3899-5170-6132.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

824-2292-2728-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2292-2728-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2292-2728-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

3129-5660-6462-7368-7824.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1477-2626-4986--44.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is modified

1458-2539-3400-4762-7784.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Devoted Druid.
Ivy triggers. Choose not to copy Banishing Knack
Resolve Banishing Knack
Cast Lion Umbra by paying {G}{G}, targeting Devoted Druid.
Ivy triggers, copying Lion Umbra twice due to Twinning Staff. Choose to have one copy target Ivy and the other copy target Devoted Druid.
Resolve all three Lion Umbras, attaching one to Ivy if it's modified and two to Devoted Druid.
Activate Devoted Druid using the ability given to it by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning the nontoken Lion Umbra from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time, then repeat step 8 one additional time.
Repeat from step 4.

3532-5078-5645-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

321-399-2475-6707-7646.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3122-4004-7149.description:
Cast Undercover Operative by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Undercover Operative into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Undercover Operative dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Undercover Operative enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Undercover Operative leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Undercover Operative from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

4186-4384-6720.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4384-6720.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

955-3259-4689.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-4689.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3129-4050-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3129-4050-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

565-1858-6898--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-6898--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar and Electro trigger.
Resolve the Electro trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

719-4338-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV<=3 that has "When ~ enters, you get at least {E}"

678-5674-6797--40.description:
Cast the creature that causes you to get energy counter(s) when it enters the battlefield by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When the creature enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get at least {E}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

3875-5720-5721-6620.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
3875-5720-5721-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers that many times, creating a Treasure token for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.
3875-5720-5721-6620.notes: If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite Treasure tokens and/or Food tokens due to Tireless Provisioner's trigger.

2512-4943-6562.description:
Cast Daru Spiritualist by paying {1}{W}.
When Daru Spiritualist enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving it +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Lancers en-Kor ability.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing an opponent to lose an arbitrarily large amount of life.

11-1235-5195-6526.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{W} plus enough mana to cast the spell that creates a token copy
11-1235-5195-6526.description:
Cast Flamehold Grappler by paying {U}{R}{W}.
When Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Cast Twinflame by paying its mana cost, targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Twinflame
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Twinflame.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Twinflame to your hand and creating a copy of Twinflame targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Twinflame copy, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast.
Activate up to four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Twinflame.
Repeat from step 3.

662-4853-4917-6429.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
662-4853-4917-6429.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Jan Jansen to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant.
When Razorlash Transmogrant dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2523-5147-5560.notablePrerequisites: Rangers of Ithilien is your Ring-bearer.
2523-5147-5560.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rangers of Ithilien.
When Rangers of Ithilien dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Rangers of Ithilien that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Rangers of Ithilien token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Rangers of Ithilien token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4050-6247-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4050-6247-6249--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the persist creature dies, it and High-Society Hunter trigger.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

4779-5365-5445.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Lonis.
4779-5365-5445.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis' second ability and Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability from step 1.
Repeat.

974-5470-5900.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-5470-5900.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Ghired.
Repeat from step 3.
974-5470-5900.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Ghired to copy any other token(s) that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and/or use Lilysplash Mentor to blink any other creature(s) as desired.

1437-1892.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-1892.description:
Cast Contagious Vorrac by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Contagious Vorrac spell three times.
Resolve the first Contagious Vorrac spell.
When the Contagious Vorrac token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-1892.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Contagious Vorrac spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

643-1636-5793.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
It is your turn.
643-1636-5793.description:
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

486-509-1267-5546.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Jhoira's Timebug does not have summoning sickness.
486-509-1267-5546.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

132-198-549-2509.notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-198-549-2509.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {U} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Merrow Wavebreakers's ability by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat.

1563-1651-1737-3342-4231.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Thieves' Tools.
When the Thieves' Tools token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure, a Clue and a Food artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Clue, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate the Thieves' Tools token and the Treasure token by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

764-3858-4969.notablePrerequisites: Colossus Hammer and Belt of Giant Strength attached to the same creature you control.
764-3858-4969.description: At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, causing you to gain ten life and win the game.

776-1329-1540-2709.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-1540-2709.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Chalice of the Void to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Chalice of the Void.
Cast Chalice of the Void.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3368-4697.notablePrerequisites: You control permanents that can tap to add at least {12}{U}{U}{R}{R}.
3368-4697.description:
Cast Reality Spasm by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting seven permanents you control.
Holding priority, Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Reality Spasm.
Resolve the Reality Spasm copy, untapping seven permanents you control.
Repeat from step 2.
